name: sfx-gen
description: Generate sound effects from text prompts with a local Stable Audio model (sa3.cpp), no API, no Python

sa3_dir.title: sa3.cpp checkout
sa3_dir.description: Folder holding sa3-generate under build-metal/bin or build/bin and models/. The installer uses ~/.claude/sa3

model.title: Model
model.description: Stable Audio model to generate with

device.title: Device
device.description: Backend. auto picks Metal on Apple Silicon, CPU elsewhere

encoding.title: Weight encoding
encoding.description: GGUF precision of the downloaded weights. Must match what models.sh fetched

duration.title: Default duration
duration.description: Clip length in seconds when a duration is not given
